findings.suggested_fix: In CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:37, set `local newv "${FIG_NEWLINKS}_cleaned"` (or set default `local newv "true"` at line 30 and keep `_cleaned` in the filename on line 95: `link`beg_yr'_1940_`newv'_cleaned_noraceblock`linksuf'.dta`). Also add `confirm file` for the `newv` link file near the top of `CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do` before loading the 43 GB `census1940_all_labeled_data.dta`.
findings.title: Target-only switch omits _cleaned from the link filename, causing merge to fail with r(601) after loading the 43 GB census file
findings.what_the_code_does: Line 30 sets `local newv "true_cleaned"`, and line 37 overrides it with `local newv "$FIG_NEWLINKS"` (`"mltgt1940"`) when `$FIG_NEWLINKS` is `"mltgt1940"`. Line 95 then runs `merge 1:1 id_B using "`intermediate'link`beg_yr'_1940_`newv'_noraceblock`linksuf'.dta"`, which expands to `link1930_1940_mltgt1940_noraceblock0.dta` (without `_cleaned`), whereas the file produced by `MATCHING/_tgt_only_run.do` and `MATCHING/3_append_and_clean_all_links_christian_torbenV2.do:149` is `link1930_1940_mltgt1940_cleaned_noraceblock0.dta`.
findings.why_it_matters: Running `MATCHING/_figs_tgt_run.do` will abort with `r(601)` (file not found) at `CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:95` after spending ~30 minutes loading the 122.5M-record 1940 census file, sorting by enumeration district, and merging the socio-demographic extract and baseline links. No target-only figures, tables, or `temp_tgt.dta` will be produced.

findings.how_to_check: Inspect `replication/check_claims.py:38-50` (`for f in sorted(results_dir.glob("*.tex")): ... if key in vals: sys.exit(f"duplicate result key \\{key} in {f.name} and {where[key]}")`) and `replication/Run-MachineA.ps1:77` (`git -C $repo status --porcelain -- replication/results/`).
findings.suggested_fix: When `sfx` is non-empty, write the target-only `repnum` files to `$REP_REPO/MATCHING/results/create_figures_SSHA2025_tgt.tex` and `$REP_REPO/MATCHING/results/compute_legibility_quartiles_tgt.tex` (matching how `MATCHING/fs_avg_performance.do:166` writes slide outputs to `MATCHING/results/`), or exclude `*_tgt.tex` in `replication/check_claims.py:40` and `replication/Run-MachineA.ps1:77`.
findings.title: Writing *_tgt.tex into replication/results/ with identical repnum keys breaks check_claims.py and Run-MachineA.ps1
findings.what_the_code_does: `CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:40` and `CODE/compute_legibility_quartiles.do:27` open `$REP_RESULTS/create_figures_SSHA2025_tgt.tex` and `$REP_RESULTS/compute_legibility_quartiles_tgt.tex` in `replication/results/` and write the exact same `repnum` LaTeX command keys (`\nRecordsTarget`, `\linkRateTargetBefore`, `\legDisagreeLowest`, etc.) as `create_figures_SSHA2025.tex` and `compute_legibility_quartiles.tex`. `replication/check_claims.py:40-47` globs all `*.tex` in `replication/results/` and exits with an error on any duplicate key across files, and `replication/Run-MachineA.ps1:77` checks `git -C $repo status --porcelain -- replication/results/` without `--untracked-files=no`.
findings.why_it_matters: Once `MATCHING/_figs_tgt_run.do` creates `replication/results/*_tgt.tex`, every subsequent run of `python replication/check_claims.py` will crash immediately with `duplicate result key`, and `replication/Run-MachineA.ps1` will fail both at the claim check and at its dirty-results check.

findings.title: all_states_effect_socio_demo.log is written without the _tgt suffix, overwriting the paper's intermediate log file

Although no downstream script reads that `.log` file after line 395, suffixing it preserves complete separation between paper and target-only artifacts.

structured_output.summary: The target-only switch in `CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do` and `CODE/compute_legibility_quartiles.do` preserves all default paths and behaviour when `$FIG_NEWLINKS` is empty, and properly suffixes the paper figures, table, and `temp.dta` when set. However, there is one blocker bug and one major replication conflict when `$FIG_NEWLINKS` is set to `mltgt1940`: `CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:37,95` sets `newv` to `"mltgt1940"` instead of `"mltgt1940_cleaned"`, so the merge looks for a non-existent `link1930_1940_mltgt1940_noraceblock0.dta` and will abort with `r(601)` after loading the 43 GB census file. In addition, writing `*_tgt.tex` with identical `repnum` keys into `replication/results/` will cause `replication/check_claims.py` to exit on duplicate keys and `replication/Run-MachineA.ps1` to fail its clean-results check.

verified_clean.evidence: When `$FIG_NEWLINKS` is `"mltgt1940"`, `sfx` is `"_tgt"`, which suffixes `temp_tgt.dta` (`CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:113,124,307`, `CODE/compute_legibility_quartiles.do:34`), `avg_performance_allstates_tgt.tex` (`CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:152`), and all seven PDF exports (`CODE/create_figures_SSHA2025.do:274,277,281,296,415,418,421`), leaving the paper's tracked figures, table, and `temp.dta` untouched.

verified_clean.evidence: `MATCHING/1c_tgt_divided_files.do:111-114` sets `mi_true_cleaned` in `divided_file1940_tgt_cleaned` to the model initial on target records (`tgt==1`) and `mi_ans` on non-target records (`!tgt`), verified by `assert r(N)==0` in `MATCHING/score_tgt_links.do:103-108` (`MATCHING/score_tgt_links.log:355-366`). `MATCHING/3_append_and_clean_all_links_christian_torbenV2.do:129-141` attaches `mi1930` from `divided_file1930_ans_cleaned` and `mi1940` (`mi_true_cleaned`) from `divided_file1940_tgt_cleaned` into `link1930_1940_mltgt1940_cleaned_noraceblock0.dta`, matching the exact convention used by `MATCHING/score_tgt_links.do:210-215`.

summary.description: Two to four sentences. The overall state of the reviewed work and the single most important thing to fix. No preamble.

dimensions_reviewed.description: Which scope dimensions were actually reviewed in this run.

findings.description: Defects and concerns, ordered most severe first. Empty if none. Do not pad with stylistic observations.

severity.description: blocker: a reported result is wrong. major: a referee would demand it. minor: real but survivable. nit: cosmetic.

confidence.description: verified: traced in the source. likely: strongly implied but depends on unseen data. speculative: a question, not an established defect.

title.description: One line, stating the defect itself, not its category.

location.description: path:line, or path:line-line. Several may be comma-separated. Required: a finding without a location is not a finding.

what_the_code_does.description: Precisely what the code computes, quoting the relevant expression. Contrast with what it was evidently intended to compute.

why_it_matters.description: The consequence for a number or claim in the paper. If there is no consequence, the severity is nit.

how_to_check.description: A concrete command, tabulation, or count the author can run to confirm or refute this in minutes.

suggested_fix.description: The change, specific enough to act on. Do not apply it yourself.

verified_clean.description: Things explicitly checked that were fine. This is what makes a short findings list trustworthy rather than lazy.

evidence.description: How it was confirmed, with path:line where applicable.

review_limits.description: What this review could NOT establish: data not readable, pipeline not runnable, paper text unavailable, Stata semantics not verifiable by reading. Be explicit; silence here reads as false assurance.
